---
tests/internal/fuzzers/CMakeLists.txt
set(UNIT_TESTS_FILES
  flb_json_fuzzer.c
  parser_fuzzer.c
  parse_json_fuzzer.c
  parse_logfmt_fuzzer.c
  parse_ltsv_fuzzer.c

    ${source_file} local_test.c
    )

  endif()
